# ExportersIndia

> India's leading B2B marketplace connecting verified manufacturers, exporters, and suppliers with global buyers across 200+ countries.

ExportersIndia serves as a comprehensive B2B directory and marketplace platform specializing in Indian manufacturers and exporters. The platform enables businesses to discover suppliers, post buyer leads, and manage product catalogs across multiple industries including home supplies, tableware, baby products, and more.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- Indian Manufacturers
- Exporters Directory
- Wholesale Sourcing
- Product Categories
- Stainless Steel Products
- Tableware & Dinnerware
- Baby Products
- Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore
- Trade Leads
- Business Catalog
- Supplier Verification
- Import-Export
- Product Pricing
- Global B2B Network

## Core Marketplace

- [India's Leading B2B Marketplace for Manufacturers, Exporters & Suppliers](https://www.exportersindia.com): Homepage connecting manufacturers, exporters, suppliers & buyers globally
- [Top B2B Seller Directory in India](https://www.exportersindia.com/industry): B2B directory connecting verified manufacturers, wholesalers & exporters in India
- [Global B2B Marketplace | Find Suppliers & Manufacturers Worldwide](https://www.exportersindia.com/b2b-marketplace.htm): Global B2B marketplace for suppliers, manufacturers & exporters from 200+ countries
- [Indian Manufacturers Directory](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-manufacturers): Indian manufacturers directory with company listings, products & industrial suppliers
- [Buy Leads & Trade Leads by Industry](https://www.exportersindia.com/buyers): Global buyer leads & trade inquiries for sourcing products & import-export

## Product Categories & Suppliers

- [Home Supplies & Garden Products](https://www.exportersindia.com/industry/home-supplies.htm): Home supplies & garden products directory with manufacturers & exporters
- [Dinnerware, Tableware and Serving Utensils](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-manufacturers/dinnerware-tableware.htm): Dinnerware & tableware manufacturers directory with stainless steel products
- [Stainless Steel Dinner Set](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-suppliers/stainless-steel-dinner-set.htm): Stainless steel dinner set manufacturers & suppliers with pricing
- [Casserole Set](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-suppliers/casserole-set.htm): Casserole set suppliers & manufacturers with pricing from Indian cities
- [Hot Case Cookware](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-suppliers/hot-case.htm): Hot case cookware suppliers & manufacturers with wholesale pricing options
- [Bowls](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-suppliers/bowls.htm): Bowls manufacturers & suppliers directory with location-based search
- [Child & Baby Care Products](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-manufacturers/baby-products.htm): Baby & child care products manufacturers & suppliers directory
- [Bio Oil](https://www.exportersindia.com/indian-suppliers/bio-oil.htm): Bio oil suppliers & manufacturers with pricing from Indian exporters
